feature: The deck order's memory, and the colour control's box
note: Two small rulings on three routes. The `/decks` rows open the sort menu, because that is where the capitalised labels are drawn and a closed trigger only shows the one in force. The colour rows press `Filters` where there is one: below 1000px the rack has NO wide form and `FilterSheet` returns null until it is opened, so a bare `goto` photographed a phone cell with no control in it. At 1300 the trigger is absent and the step is skipped, which is why it is `clickIfPresent` — the box that was lopsided is the wide form, and the sheet form draws no box at all. No `shares` block: the colour control is already one component (`ui/colour-pips.tsx` inside `rack/colour-control.tsx`), which is why one 6px padding fixed both lanes at once. Steps are Playwright verbs.
